title: cosmogenerating
description: The generator morphism extending articulation to the cosmos. Restriction of aperiodic-extension to the articulation germ run to totality; output is the cosmos (codomain). Aperiodic by necessity: κ ≥ ω₁, H¹ ≠ 0, the base-extending corner that introduces new entities/facts and requires the outside (empirical correspondence). Domain: aperiodic-articulation-category. Codomain: informational-spacetime (the aperiodic base field earlier called the cosmos; cosmos is reserved for a downstream restriction). Extends: aperiodic-extension.
